var-definitions.name: descent-cap
var-definitions.doc:
Fastest descent rate (rows/s) that still leaves the main engine room to
   brake to the safe touchdown speed from this altitude, with a 30% margin
   for the per-tick bang-bang overshoot. High up this cruises fast - a
   hover-descent at the gentle final rate burns the whole tank before the
   ground arrives once gravity escalates; near the ground it tapers to the
   gentle final-approach rate. The vertical braking force is the cos
   component of the axial main thrust, so the current lean shrinks the
   budget.

var-definitions.name: commands
var-definitions.doc:
Thrust flags for this tick. Under tilt physics the side engines are
   attitude thrusters, so the brain flies an attitude plan: pick a target
   lean from the lateral velocity error (lean toward where the pad wants
   us to accelerate), fade that lean to zero near the ground so the craft
   is level at touchdown, and bang-bang the side engines on the spin rate
   to track the plan. The main engine fires along the axis to brake the
   descent, and that burn doubles as the lateral engine: the lean picks
   how much of it goes sideways. Pure function of the game state; returns
   {:up? bool :left? bool :right? bool}.

var-definitions.name: col->x
var-definitions.doc: Pixel x of the center of grid column `col`.

var-definitions.name: row->y
var-definitions.doc: Pixel y of the center of grid row `row`.

var-definitions.name: ground-row
var-definitions.doc:
Top row index occupied by ground at `col`. Same formula as the sim's
   (moonlander.core) and the ASCII renderer's copies; `terrain` carries its
   own :rows, so no config is needed here.

var-definitions.name: star-instances
var-definitions.doc:
Per-frame star field as [{:x :y :alpha :layer}] in logical pixels.
   Positions mirror the ASCII renderer's math exactly (same lander-relative
   parallax offsets and per-star screen wrap); the binary glyph twinkle is
   smoothed into a per-star alpha oscillation, phase-shifted by the star's
   coordinates so the field never pulses in lockstep. Pure function of :t.

var-definitions.name: terrain-ridge
var-definitions.doc:
Step outline of the ridge line as a flat sequence of [x y] pixel point
   pairs, left to right: for each column the top edge of its ground cell,
   stepped (the ASCII renderer's per-column `#`/`/` top made continuous).

var-definitions.name: pad-geometry
var-definitions.doc:
Pad geometry in pixels: the surface line span, the two support struts
   under the pad edges, and the beacon anchor above the pad center.

var-definitions.name: beacon-alpha
var-definitions.doc:
Beacon lamp brightness: the ASCII beacon's 2 Hz on/off blink smoothed
   into a sine pulse. Pure function of :t.

var-definitions.name: lander-transform
var-definitions.doc:
Lander sprite transform: pixel position and rotation in radians. x maps
   the float grid position straight to pixels, so the sprite sits inside
   the screen column of `(int x)` - the column the sim tests for pad and
   ground contact; y is the row center, so the feet meet the ground. `angle` is
   degrees from level, positive = top tips right; with the canvas y axis
   pointing down that is a positive (clockwise) Pixi rotation.

var-definitions.name: flame-state
var-definitions.doc:
Per-frame flame visibility and animation frame for the three engines,
   from the same inputs the ASCII flames consume: the effective :burn
   flags, fuel, and flight status (flames only while flying with fuel).
   `fr` is the 12 Hz animation frame the ASCII flame glyphs use.

var-definitions.name: main-flame-scale
var-definitions.doc:
Main flame length/brightness flicker: the ASCII flame's two glyph rows
   cycle at 12 Hz (3 and 4 glyphs); folded into a scale pulse.

var-definitions.name: side-flame-alpha
var-definitions.doc:
Side thruster puff brightness flicker (the ASCII side flames' 3-glyph
   cycle folded into alpha).

var-definitions.name: smoke-max-drift
var-definitions.doc: Ceiling (px) on the smoke's upward drift: two rows above the wreck.

var-definitions.name: explosion-scene
var-definitions.doc:
Explosion visuals for state `:explosion {:x :y :t0}` at time `t`.
   Returns {:phase :fireball | :smoke :particles [{:x :y :r :alpha :hot?}]}
   in pixels. Fireball for the first 1.5 s (the ASCII renderer's filled
   disc): particles fly out from the impact point and fade. Then the same
   lingering smoke as the ASCII renderer (its fixed cell offsets), drifting
   slowly upward up to `smoke-max-drift` px so it stays over the wreck,
   flickering on the same 10 Hz clock.

var-definitions.name: overlay-message
var-definitions.doc:
The end-of-round overlay text, or nil while flying / mid-round. Same
   condition the ASCII overlay uses.

var-definitions.name: ground-row
var-definitions.doc: Top row index occupied by ground at `col`.

var-definitions.name: draw-stars
var-definitions.doc:
Far stars are static and twinkle slowly; near stars drift against the
   lander's position (parallax) and twinkle faster. Drawn first, so terrain
   and the lander always overwrite them.

var-definitions.name: draw-pad
var-definitions.doc:
Landing pad detail: support struts under the pad edges and a blinking
   beacon above the pad center.

var-definitions.name: lander-cells
var-definitions.doc:
ASCII glyph cells [drow dcol char] for the lander at `angle` degrees
   (positive = top tips right). A few angle buckets get visibly rotated
   glyphs: level within 7.5 deg, a lean bucket to 20 deg, and past that a
   hard-lean bucket that folds the leading leg.

var-definitions.name: draw-lander
var-definitions.doc: The lander, with animated flame while engines burn (flying, fuel left).

var-definitions.name: draw-explosion
var-definitions.doc:
Expanding blast of flickering characters at the crash site, fading to a
   wisp of smoke. Frame is derived from the time since impact.

var-definitions.name: render
var-definitions.doc: Returns the full screen as a single string.

var-definitions.name: glow-dot-texture
var-definitions.doc:
A soft glow dot baked to a RenderTexture: halo + mid + hot core. Baked
   at 2x resolution so sprites stay crisp on retina displays.

var-definitions.name: lander-texture
var-definitions.doc:
The lander as a procedural vector-glow asset: an Apollo-flavoured LM
   (ascent cabin with amber windows, descent stage, splayed legs with
   footpads, engine nozzle, antenna, RCS quads) drawn with Graphics and
   baked once. Drawn in lander-local coordinates: origin at the rotation
   center, feet resting at +7.5 px (the boundary the sim lands on). Baked
   with an explicit frame so the anchor below marks the rotation center,
   not the texture center.

var-definitions.name: main-flame-texture
var-definitions.doc: Main engine flame: layered teardrop pointing down, origin at the nozzle.

var-definitions.name: side-flame-texture
var-definitions.doc: RCS thruster puff: horizontal jet pointing +x, origin at the nozzle tip.

var-definitions.name: flat-points
var-definitions.doc: Flatten [[x y] ...] into a plain JS number array for Pixi path calls.

var-definitions.name: draw-pad-graphics!
var-definitions.doc:
Pad surface (glowing line), support struts, and the beacon anchor
   position, all from the pure pad geometry.

var-definitions.name: rebuild-terrain!
var-definitions.doc:
Redraw the terrain body + glowing ridge and the pad, and reposition the
   beacon. Runs once per round.

var-definitions.name: rebuild-stars!
var-definitions.doc:
One glow-dot sprite per star, in its parallax layer's container. Runs
   once per round; per-frame updates only touch x/y/alpha.

var-definitions.name: update-lander!
var-definitions.doc:
Position/rotate the lander sprite from state and drive the three engine
   flames from the same :burn data the ASCII flames consume. While a crash
   explosion runs the lander is hidden (the ASCII renderer draws the
   explosion instead of the craft too).

var-definitions.name: update-explosion!
var-definitions.doc:
Drive the pooled particle sprites from the deterministic explosion
   scene: fireball for the first 1.5 s, then lingering smoke.

var-definitions.name: sync-overlay!
var-definitions.doc:
End-of-round message as a DOM panel over the canvas (ASCII draws it
   into the grid; pixi keeps it as crisp text). DOM is touched only when
   the message actually changes.

var-definitions.name: ensure-static!
var-definitions.doc:
Rebuild round-scene display objects when the state's terrain or star
   field identity changed. Returns the current renderer state.

var-definitions.name: prepare-dom!
var-definitions.doc:
Create the #screen-stage wrapper (position context for the end-of-round
   overlay) and the overlay element, without touching the live DOM yet.

var-definitions.name: mount-dom!
var-definitions.doc:
Insert the stage wrapper right after the ASCII <pre> and hide the
   <pre>. Runs last in startup: until this point the ASCII view is
   untouched, so a startup failure leaves the fallback fully intact. The
   <pre> element stays in the DOM: the ASCII renderer reclaims it whenever
   it is the active one (fallback, ?renderer=ascii).

var-definitions.name: build-scene!
var-definitions.doc:
Construct the layer containers, textures, and pooled display objects on
   the stage. Layer order: far stars, near stars, terrain, pad, beacon,
   lander (flames ride as children so they inherit its rotation), the
   explosion particles on top.

var-definitions.name: start!
var-definitions.doc:
Seam start fn for :pixi. Boots the Pixi application (async in v8),
   builds the scene, mounts the canvas and returns the live renderer map.
   Any failure - no WebGL2/WebGPU, init error - rejects, and the seam
   stays on ASCII (the automatic fallback).

var-definitions.name: register!
var-definitions.doc:
Register a renderer implementation's start fn under `id`. Called at
   namespace load by renderer implementations (e.g. moonlander.render.pixi).

var-definitions.name: ascii-renderer
var-definitions.doc:
The always-available renderer: writes the ASCII frame into <pre
   id="screen">. `config` rides along per call so hot reload picks up
   display-config changes.

var-definitions.name: requested-renderer
var-definitions.doc:
The renderer the environment asks for: `?renderer=<id>` in the page URL
   wins over `window.MOONLANDER_CONFIG.RENDERER`; both are optional and
   parse to a keyword (nil when unset/unparseable). Kept separate from
   `start!` so selection is auditable and cheap to test.

var-definitions.name: start!
var-definitions.doc:
Resolve and start the renderer for this session. Always installs the
   ASCII renderer first so every frame has a working draw path; when a
   different renderer was requested and is registered, starts it and swaps
   it in once ready. A start failure (rejected promise or thrown error)
   leaves ASCII active - the automatic fallback for WebGL-less browsers.

var-definitions.name: draw!
var-definitions.doc:
Render one frame of `state` through the active renderer. No-op before
   `start!` (and headlessly, where no renderer is ever started).

var-definitions.name: active-renderer-id
var-definitions.doc:
The id of the live renderer (:ascii, :pixi, ...). Diagnostic for the
   review console and future telemetry.

var-definitions.name: make-rng
var-definitions.doc:
Returns a deterministic PRNG (linear congruential generator) as a
   zero-arg fn yielding doubles in [0, 1).

var-definitions.name: base-params
var-definitions.doc:
Level-1 physics and tuning; `params-for-level` escalates from here.
   Scaled for the display grid in moonlander.core/config (120x43).
   Gravity is deliberately gentler than the classic 9.0: the whole curve
   is scaled by 0.9 so descents are a touch more forgiving.

var-definitions.name: params-for-level
var-definitions.doc:
Difficulty escalates with level: stronger gravity, less fuel, narrower
   pads, and rougher terrain. (The moon is an airless body: the old
   cross-wind parameter was removed outright, not replaced - the
   remaining four escalation axes still steepen the curve on their own.)

var-definitions.name: pad-name
var-definitions.doc:
Apollo-era designation for the landing pad on `level`, e.g.
   "TRANQUILITY PAD 03". The name cycles through `pad-names`; the pad
   number is the level number (zero-padded).

var-definitions.name: level-seed
var-definitions.doc: Derives the generation seed for `level` from the game's base seed.

var-definitions.name: gen-terrain
var-definitions.doc:
Random-walk ridge heights with one flat landing pad segment.
   Returns {:heights [int per column] :pad {:start :end} :rows rows};
   :rows rides along so consumers (e.g. the autopilot) can locate the
   ground without mirroring the display config.

var-definitions.name: gen-stars
var-definitions.doc:
Background star field: a vector of {:x :y :layer}. Layer 0 stars are far
   (static), layer 1 stars are near (they drift against the lander's motion
   for a parallax effect). Stars stay above the terrain band: the y range
   respects the level's max-terrain relief, so no star ever spawns inside
   the ground even on the roughest high levels.

var-definitions.name: config
var-definitions.doc:
The leaderboard config value, or nil when not configured. Reads
   window.MOONLANDER_CONFIG (public/config.js) and requires both values.

var-definitions.name: record-tick
var-definitions.doc:
Append one frame to the recording. `burn` is the effective thrust applied
   by `step` this tick ({:up? :left? :right?}). Frames with dt outside the
   server's accepted range are dropped (a zero-dt frame changes no physics);
   past the server's tick cap the recording stops and is flagged :capped?.

var-definitions.name: callsign-pattern
var-definitions.doc:
Server-side rule (submit-score): 1-16 chars of [A-Za-z0-9 _.-], starting
   alphanumeric.

var-definitions.name: landing-flag
var-definitions.doc: Wire value for the AUTO/MANUAL flag: "auto" | "manual" | nil.

var-definitions.name: landing-mode-from-flag
var-definitions.doc:
Inverse of `landing-flag`: a board row's wire value back to :auto/:manual/
   nil. Used to seed replay playback with the mode recorded at verification
   time (see moonlander.core/apply-recorded-landing-mode).

var-definitions.name: payload
var-definitions.doc:
Submit body for POST {SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/submit-score:
   {callsign, seed, level, landing_flag, ticks[{dt,up,left,right}]}.
   The score itself is derived server-side from the verified replay; the
   client never claims one.

var-definitions.name: flag-label
var-definitions.doc: Display label for a board row's landing flag.

var-definitions.name: fit
var-definitions.doc: Fit `s` into exactly `n` chars: truncate or pad on the right.

var-definitions.name: fit-left
var-definitions.doc: Fit `s` into exactly `n` chars: truncate or pad on the left.

var-definitions.name: board-row-text
var-definitions.doc:
One board line from a PostgREST row (string keys): rank, callsign,
   score, level, AUTO/MANUAL flag, fuel remaining.

var-definitions.name: board-head-text
var-definitions.doc: Board title, rule, and column header - the fixed part above the rows.

var-definitions.name: board-text
var-definitions.doc:
Full ASCII board with title, header, and one line per row; the
   `empty-message` shows when the board has no entries (e.g. the daily board
   right after the nightly reset).

var-definitions.name: replay-log-from-row
var-definitions.doc:
Parse a stored flight log from a `score_replays` read-path row
   (string keys) into a replayable log {:id :seed :level :ticks}, or nil
   when the row carries no usable log: legacy rows predate the ticks
   column (NULL) and corrupt logs fail the same shape checks the server
   applies at submit time. The watch action degrades to 'replay
   unavailable' on nil - it must never crash the boards UI.

var-definitions.name: replay-speeds
var-definitions.doc: Playback speed cycle for the SPEED toggle: 1x -> 2x -> 4x -> 1x.

var-definitions.name: cycle-replay-speed
var-definitions.doc:
Cycle a playback map's :speed through `replay-speeds`; a missing or
   unrecognized speed (e.g. the :loading/:unavailable window, which has no
   :speed key yet) resets to 1x rather than erroring.

var-definitions.name: record!
var-definitions.doc:
Game-loop hook: record one simulated frame. `s` is the pre-step state,
   `burn` the post-step effective thrust. Starts a fresh recording whenever
   the round identity (seed, level) changes or the clock rewinds (retry or
   new game reusing a seed).

var-definitions.name: append-board!
var-definitions.doc:
Build one board as DOM: the fixed header as a <pre>, then one line per
   row with a WATCH action (replay theater) when the row carries its id.

var-definitions.name: replay-status!
var-definitions.doc: Set the replay bar's status line (also used by the playback driver).

var-definitions.name: watch!
var-definitions.doc:
WATCH action on a board row: fetch the run's archived flight log via
   the anon read path and open the replay bar. The playback driver in
   moonlander.core picks the log up from (:replay @ui). A legacy row (log
   predates the ticks column) or a malformed log degrades to a clear
   'replay unavailable' state - the boards UI keeps working.

var-definitions.name: on-round-ended!
var-definitions.doc:
Round ended (landed or crashed): with config, bring up the telemetry
   panel. The callsign prompt appears only for a safe landing - submit time
   is the only moment a nickname is asked for.

var-definitions.name: on-new-round!
var-definitions.doc: A fresh round started (next level, retry, new game): put the panel away.

var-definitions.name: toggle-boards!
var-definitions.doc: Toggle the boards from the end-of-round screen ([L] key / BOARDS button).

var-definitions.name: submit!
var-definitions.doc:
Transmit the recorded run for server verification. Validates the callsign
   against the server rule before sending; the score comes back from the
   verified replay.

var-definitions.name: init-ui!
var-definitions.doc:
Wire the telemetry panel controls once at game start. With no config the
   panel stays hidden and the page is exactly as before.

var-definitions.name: new-round
var-definitions.doc:
Start a new game. With no arguments picks a random base seed; pass a
   seed (and optionally a level) for deterministic, reproducible rounds.

var-definitions.name: next-level
var-definitions.doc: Fresh round on the next level, same base seed.

var-definitions.name: retry-level
var-definitions.doc: Fresh round on the same level (identical terrain), same base seed.

var-definitions.name: ground-row
var-definitions.doc: Top row index occupied by ground at `col`.

var-definitions.name: touchdown-message
var-definitions.doc:
The end-of-round overlay/message text for a touchdown or crash at `level`,
   tagged with the AUTO/MANUAL `mode`. Factored out of `step` so the replay
   driver can rebuild it when overriding the displayed landing mode.

var-definitions.name: assist-flags
var-definitions.doc:
Always-on landing assist: near the ground, adds thrust to cap the descent
   rate and horizontal speed at the safe-landing limits. It only ever ADDS
   thrust - it dampens, it does not fly the ship - and it never sets the
   AUTO flag. It burns the player's fuel; with a dry tank there is nothing
   to burn and it stays out of the way. The caps sit at 75% of the safe
   limits, leaving margin for the per-tick bang-bang overshoot.

var-definitions.name: step
var-definitions.doc:
Pure state transition. `dt` is seconds elapsed. Elapsed time `:t` always
   advances (it drives the animations), even after the round has ended.

var-definitions.name: render
var-definitions.doc:
ASCII rendering of one frame, as a single string. Thin delegate to
   moonlander.render.ascii/render (the headless test oracle).

var-definitions.name: lander-cells
var-definitions.doc:
ASCII glyph cells for the lander at a given angle; thin alias of
   moonlander.render.ascii/lander-cells.

var-definitions.name: hud-readout
var-definitions.doc:
Mission-control style HUD readout as pure data (testable headlessly).
   Fixed labels and units: ALT 0380 M, VS +11 M/S, HS +02 M/S, PROP 74%,
   plus the level, the target pad designation, and the guidance mode
   (GUID: AUTO while hold-A autoland flies, ASSIST while the landing assist
   is dampening, MAN otherwise; the latched AUTO/MANUAL flag once down).

var-definitions.name: replay-start
var-definitions.doc:
Build the playback state for a parsed flight log (see
   moonlander.leaderboard/replay-log-from-row). A nil log (legacy or
   corrupt row) yields the :unavailable state - never a crash.

var-definitions.name: replay-frame-after
var-definitions.doc:
Simulate one logged tick from the previous frame: the recorded effective
   flags applied as raw stick input, then one deterministic `step`. This is
   exactly the server verifier's replay path (the recorded burn already
   contains the autopilot/assist output).

var-definitions.name: apply-recorded-landing-mode
var-definitions.doc:
Override a just-landed/crashed replay frame's displayed AUTO/MANUAL flag
   with the mode recorded at verification time. Replaying the recorded
   *effective* thrust flags alone can't tell whether hold-A autoland was
   engaged (the server only stores the merged burn, not the raw `:auto?`
   stick), so the real flag has to ride along with the log instead.

var-definitions.name: replay-advance
var-definitions.doc:
Pure playback step: advance through the log by `wall-dt` seconds of real
   time, consuming logged ticks at their recorded pace scaled by :speed.
   Frames are extended lazily (frame i is the state after i ticks). At the
   end of the log the playback parks on the final frame with :playing?
   false. A paused or finished playback returns unchanged.

var-definitions.name: typing-callsign?
var-definitions.doc:
True when the event comes from the leaderboard callsign input, so game
   keys (thrust, A, R, L) stay out of the way while typing a nickname.

var-definitions.name: replay-tick!
var-definitions.doc:
Replay theater owns the screen: advance playback by the elapsed wall
   time and render the current replay frame. The pilot's own round is
   frozen (not stepped, not recorded) until the replay is closed.
